ApartmentReadingsResponse.title: ApartmentReadingsResponse
ApartmentReadingsResponse.description: One apartment's readings across the latest periods (the E8 card and the resident's chart).

ApartmentSummary.title: ApartmentSummary
ApartmentSummary.description: An apartment in the board's list of cards (epic E8): counts of members, no people.

BindingView.title: BindingView
BindingView.description: A linked chat or device; the address itself (chat id, endpoint) is never returned.

BuildingResponse.title: BuildingResponse
BuildingResponse.description: The association and its building; public within the building (no people in it).

CardResident.title: CardResident
CardResident.description: A member on an apartment card: only the relation and since when, never who.

EmergencyView.title: EmergencyView
EmergencyView.description: An active emergency for the banner; acknowledged_at is the caller's own acknowledgement.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
Body of every error response. The frontend picks its text by error_code.

Some errors add fields of their own (e.g. `required_confirmation_level`,
`allowed_statuses`, `unknown_apartment_ids`); docs/API.md lists them per endpoint.

InvitationPreview.title: InvitationPreview
InvitationPreview.description: What an invitation grants, shown to the holder of its link only.

LinkCodeResponse.title: LinkCodeResponse
LinkCodeResponse.description: A one-time Telegram link code; shown once, only its hash is stored.

Locale.title: Locale
Locale.description: Language of notifications sent outside the app (the API itself is English only).

MasterMeterRow.title: MasterMeterRow
MasterMeterRow.description: A Building Master Meter in the matrix: its id is what the board submits against.

ReadingSubmitRequest.title: ReadingSubmitRequest
ReadingSubmitRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/meters/readings (the 2-step anomaly flow uses confirmation_level).

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse
SessionResponse.description: What a sign-in or a refresh returns; the refresh cookie travels next to it.

SignInResponse.title: SignInResponse
SignInResponse.description: The answer of redeeming a link or registering (docs/API.md 7).

StaffRole.title: StaffRole
StaffRole.description: The building roles a STAFF invitation can give (USER is no staff role).

SubmissionStatus.title: SubmissionStatus
SubmissionStatus.description: Per meter and per apartment in the chairman matrix.

TargetScope.title: TargetScope
TargetScope.description:
Who an alert or notice is meant for. Communication posts and notification recipients
share this enum and the matching rule `property.policies.apartment_in_target`.

UnsubscribeResponse.title: UnsubscribeResponse
UnsubscribeResponse.description: What one unsubscribe turned off (N8): one event type on e-mail.

VapidPublicKeyResponse.title: VapidPublicKeyResponse
VapidPublicKeyResponse.description: The application server key for `pushManager.subscribe` (base64url, 65 bytes).

WebPushSubscriptionRequest.title: WebPushSubscriptionRequest
WebPushSubscriptionRequest.description: `PushSubscription.toJSON()` plus a label; `expirationTime` and other fields are ignored.
